verdicts.statement: An incoming request failing to match any policy is not automatically lost.
verdicts.reason: The context specifies that an unmatched request is redirected to an HTTPS redirect listener, if present, or otherwise to the default pool.

verdicts.statement: The load balancer redirects an incoming request failing to match any policy to the configured HTTPS redirect listener, when an HTTPS redirect listener is present.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that requests matching no policy are redirected to the configured HTTPS redirect listener, if present.

verdicts.statement: The load balancer redirects an incoming request failing to match any policy to the listener default pool when no HTTPS redirect listener is present.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that unmatched requests go to the default pool of the listener when no configured HTTPS redirect listener is present.

verdicts.statement: The remedy for unmatched incoming requests is to verify the configuration of the intended fallback destination.
verdicts.reason: The context describes fallback routing but does not recommend verifying fallback configuration as a remedy.

verdicts.statement: The intended fallback destination can be an HTTPS redirect listener or a listener default pool.
verdicts.reason: The context identifies the configured HTTPS redirect listener and the listener default pool as the two fallback destinations for unmatched requests.

verdicts.statement: Policy rules can also be adjusted to address unmatched incoming requests.
verdicts.reason: The context explains how rules determine policy matching but does not state that adjusting rules is a remedy for unmatched requests.

verdicts.statement: A policy applies only when all rules associated with the policy match.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that a policy is applied only when all its rules are matched.

verdicts.statement: Multiple policies can be attached to a listener.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly permits attaching more than one policy to a listener.

verdicts.statement: Policies attached to the same listener must have distinct priorities.
verdicts.reason: The context states that multiple policies can be attached to a listener and that each policy must have a different priority.

verdicts.statement: The supplied documentation does not establish the outcome when the fallback destination is unavailable.
verdicts.reason: The context describes fallback selection but provides no outcome for an unavailable fallback destination.

verdicts.statement: The supplied documentation does not guarantee successful service for all traffic when the fallback destination is unavailable.
verdicts.reason: The context provides no guarantee of successful service when a fallback destination is unavailable.
